title: anymore. Box it came in is Nice.
text:
I was one of the original subscribers but stopped a while back because the boxes were getting barren and the prices were going down on the pops that came in them.
I thought that things would change now that Amazon is offering them.
Man was that not the case... I received it with 3 things in the box, no pin or patch, the shirt was very cheap looking and the pop was dented. I would normally say shipping dented it but it was on the inside where it wasnt near the outside of the box and there was no scuffs on the new high polish box. The actual box arrived better than the pop did. So I'm going to be cancelling my sub AGAIN. Btw the pops arent exclusive anymore. I found this out after seeing the same one at the local walmart and calling the customer service line. They confirmed that the pops are NOT exclusive. So no real reason to get this box anymore.

Not sure why Amazon flagged this as Sensitive language. It seems anytime I give a bad review they flag it for language.
label: negative
